csv_project_name: Design Services for Athletic Performance Center
csv_agency: University at Albany Architecture Engineering CM
csv_scope_of_work: Full Architectural and Engineering services that shall include but not be limited to; program phase, schematic design, design manual, construction documents and construction administration for the Project. The design service disciplines anticipated to be provided by the consultant are as follows: Architectural, Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, HVAC, Fire Protection, Civil, Structural, Asbestos Abatement and AV-Data-Security systems. All services shall align with the SUNY Consultant Agreement. The project will consist of the following additional services:site survey for underground utilities location; SEQRA study, Physical space inventory drawing development, electronic as-built drawings, interior FFE design services, audio/video design services and the creation of marketing materials that include interior and exterior renderings of the schematic design of the visitor experience improvements.

title: Design Services for Athletic Performance Center
short_description: A university seeks full design services for a new athletic performance center.
project_scope: Full architectural and engineering design for an athletic performance center at the University at Albany. Scope includes program phase, schematic design, design manual, construction documents, and construction administration. Additional services include underground utility survey, SEQRA study, physical space inventory drawing development, electronic as-built drawings, interior FF&E design, audio/video design, and marketing materials with interior and exterior renderings for visitor experience improvements.
services: Full A/E services including architectural, structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire protection, asbestos abatement, and AV/data/security systems; plus survey, environmental review, as-built documentation, FF&E, AV design, renderings, and construction administration.
relevance_explanation:
- Sports-related building project, which is generally relevant to sbp.
- Includes structural engineering within a full multidisciplinary design scope.
- However, no special structural features, long spans, innovative roof structures, or unusual engineering challenges are stated.
- Appears to be a conventional athletic building rather than a signature stadium or arena.
- Strategic relevance is moderate because early-stage design services are included.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Useful scope indicators: full design services for an athletic performance center including complete A/E disciplines, construction documents, and construction administration, but no area, capacity, or technical size data are provided, so a realistic cost estimate is not reliable.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The notice only describes a full multidisciplinary A/E services procurement under the SUNY Consultant Agreement.
references_qualifications: All disciplines requested. Consultant must provide full architectural and engineering services aligned with the SUNY Consultant Agreement. No explicit minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
